name: file-dispatcher
description: Process every file dropped into a directory exactly once, after it is fully written, even when fs.watch drops events.

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node ./scripts/test.js
